description: Eight rows of signal, each with a mute that holds off until a chosen point in the clock before it takes effect

params.text: Arms the mute for that row, or disarms it again; the change lands at the next point the row's ratio knob picks out, or at once when that knob is at Immediate
Chooses when an armed mute for that row lands: Immediate at the centre, /1 to /32 anticlockwise for once every that many clock ticks, and X1 to X32 clockwise for that many times within one clock tick

inputs.text: The signal for that row, passed to the output of the same number and silenced while that row is muted
Sets the tick every ratio counts against, on each rising edge; with no cable the module counts its own tick every 0.5 seconds
Restarts the tick count on a rising edge and lands every armed mute at once

outputs.text: The signal from the input of the same number, silenced while that row is muted

notes: a mute fades in and out over a short ramp rather than cutting, until Soft Transition is switched off for that row
the lamp inside a mute button glows red while that row is muted and blinks green while a change is armed and has not yet landed
an output with nothing patched to the input of the same number carries no channels at all
presses, clock and reset passed from one Smute travel on down a row of them; a Smute with its own cable in CLOCK uses that in place of the clock it is sent
menu: Automatically Press — right-click a mute button; re-arms that row at every ratio point, so the row switches on and off for as long as this is on
Soft Transition — right-click a mute button; switched off, the row is cut and restored at once in place of fading
Random Ratio Ranges — right-click a mute button; two sliders, Range Left and Range Right, that let the row's ratio jump to a random neighbour each time a mute lands
Light Opacity — right-click a mute button; sets how bright that row's lamp is, 0 to 100 per cent
Toggle Left Expander — sends this module's button presses, clock and reset to the Smute immediately to its left
Toggle Right Expander — sends this module's button presses, clock and reset to the Smute immediately to its right
Global Light Opacity — sets how bright every lamp on this module is, 0 to 100 per cent

inputs.8:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads an internal tick every 0.5 seconds.
inputs.9:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
